scripts.test:quality: pnpm --filter web typecheck && pnpm --filter web lint && pnpm --filter web test && pnpm --filter web build
scripts.test:e2e:local: E2E_MODE=local-smoke E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:4173 pnpm --filter web exec playwright test e2e/smoke.spec.ts e2e/security-public.spec.ts e2e/static-routes.spec.ts --project=chromium
scripts.test:e2e:deploy: E2E_MODE=deploy-smoke E2E_BASE_URL=https://ledjer.id pnpm --filter web exec playwright test e2e/smoke.spec.ts e2e/security-public.spec.ts e2e/static-routes.spec.ts --project=chromium
scripts.test:e2e:cross-browser-smoke: E2E_CROSS_BROWSER=1 pnpm --filter web exec playwright test e2e/smoke.spec.ts e2e/accessibility.spec.ts e2e/responsive.spec.ts --project=firefox --project=webkit
scripts.test:visual: E2E_VISUAL=1 pnpm --filter web exec playwright test e2e/visual.spec.ts --project=chromium
scripts.test:perf: E2E_MODE=local-smoke pnpm --filter web exec playwright test e2e/performance.spec.ts --project=chromium
scripts.test:a11y: E2E_MODE=local-smoke pnpm --filter web exec playwright test e2e/accessibility.spec.ts --project=chromium
